Pretupid Client 0.1.9 fixes startup on Minecraft 1.21.2 and 1.21.3, gives Screenies and the Meme Editor more control, and cleans up the Minimap and main menu.

## What's new

### Screenie Studio and Meme Editor
- **Frame your picture:** zoom in with the slider or mouse wheel and drag the picture to reposition it, for example to fit an aspect ratio.
- **Hide things:** turn off nametags, other players or other entities and the picture is retaken. Everything stays visible by default.
- **Text angle:** rotate any text. The layout presets are still there.
- **Placeholder text:** Text 1 and Text 2 show how a layout will look and never appear in a saved or shared image unless you type them.

### Freecam
- **Free move:** a new option that flies in the direction you are looking, including up and down.

### Modules
- Cinematic Studio now starts on for new users. Your saved settings stay as they are.

## Fixes
- **Minecraft 1.21.2 and 1.21.3:** the client no longer crashes at startup.
- **Chat emoji:** the emoji button, categories, emoji and suggestions respond to clicks again on Minecraft 26.3.
- **Privacy:** with Online services off, the client no longer looks up nearby and tab-list players.
- **Minimap:** new pixel art for your position, waypoints, edge markers and north.
- **Main menu:** removed the line under hovered buttons.
- **Icons:** fixed missing textures for Speedrun Timer, Now Playing, Light Level and the death point notification.

## Downloads
- **Client mod:** pick the jar that includes your Minecraft version, for example `pretupid-client-0.1.9+mc26.3.jar` or `pretupid-client-0.1.9+mc1.21.6-1.21.7.jar`
- **Source:** the source code archives below

The launcher updates Pretupid Client to 0.1.9 on its own, and the client offers the update in-game as well.
